text:
Type: dark grey clamp spotlight
Use: directed reading or accent light clamped to a desk, shelf or bed; home office, bedroom, living room
Style: industrial, retro
Materials: textured dark grey powder-coated metal shade and bracket, black steel screw clamp, black cord
Colors: dark charcoal grey, black
Shape: deep flared bell shade on a tilting bracket with a large knob, screw clamp, chunky and compact, heavy-looking for its size
Feel: rugged, utilitarian, moody, sturdy
Goes with: wood shelves, concrete, brick, black metal; industrial home offices, lofts and workshops

product.name: HEKTAR
product.description: The lamp has got double function - you can use it as a clamp spotlight or assemble it on the wall as a wall lamp.
